description: This source file defines the ResourceLimits class, which encapsulates resource limit configurations such as maximum connections, TTL, data volume, and extensions for tenants in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: ResourceLimits
classes.description: A class that models resource limit settings, including maximum connections, TTL, data volume, and extension properties, with setters and getters for fluent configuration.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of connections allowed for a tenant, with validation to prevent values less than -1.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of connections allowed.

methods.name: setMaxTtl
methods.description: Sets the maximum TTL in seconds for events published by devices of a tenant, with validation.

methods.name: getDataVolume
methods.description: Gets the DataVolume properties related to message size limits.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Sets custom extension properties for resource limits.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension property by key.
